name: /deploy-status Telegram command — Achiri alpha deploy checklist
goal: handleDeployStatus() — owner-only Telegram command that shows a complete Achiri deploy checklist: which env vars are set vs missing, whether Achiri API is reachable (pings /health), alpha gate config status, invite count. Output: a checklist with ✅/❌/⏳ for each prerequisite + a 'what remains' action list. Helps operator deploy Achiri to Hetzner for Apr 25 alpha without guessing what's left.
rationale: Apr 25 Achiri alpha (40d away). All code is done (Sprints 129-131). Operator needs to: (1) set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on Hetzner, (2) run deploy-achiri.sh, (3) set ACHIRI_BASE_URL in bot .env, (4) set ACHIRI_ALPHA_ONLY=true. There's no single command to see which of these are done. /deploy-status closes that gap — operator runs it from Telegram and sees exactly what's remaining.
swarm: NOT USED — 2 file edits + 1 validation script. Direct write.

tasks.title: commands.ts — handleDeployStatus() + handleHelp update
tasks.description: Add handleDeployStatus(chatId, ownerChatId): owner-only. Checks: (1) ACHIRI_BASE_URL: set to non-localhost? ✅ else ⚠️ 'Set ACHIRI_BASE_URL=http://65.108.90.178/achiri in .env'. (2) ACHIRI_ALPHA_ONLY: set to 'true'? ✅ else ⏳ 'Set ACHIRI_ALPHA_ONLY=true when ready to gate alpha'. (3) Achiri API health: ping ACHIRI_BASE_URL/health (3s timeout) → ✅ UP (latency) or ❌ DOWN. (4) File whitelist: count from alpha-whitelist.jsonl. (5) Waitlist: count from waitlist.jsonl. (6) deploy-achiri.sh: existsSync('scripts/deploy-achiri.sh') → ✅/❌. Build checklist message and show remaining steps. Add '/deploy-status — Achiri alpha deploy checklist (owner)' to handleHelp() under Achiri section.
